# ILitePSM
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/sky/ILitePSM.sol)

**Title:**
ILitePSM

Minimal interface for the Sky/Maker LitePSM (Peg Stability Module)


## Functions
### sellGem

Sells gem (collateral) tokens for the stablecoin


```solidity
function sellGem(address usr, uint256 gemAmt) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usr`|`address`|The recipient of the stablecoin|
|`gemAmt`|`uint256`|The amount of gem tokens to sell|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of stablecoin received|


### buyGem

Buys gem (collateral) tokens with the stablecoin


```solidity
function buyGem(address usr, uint256 gemAmt) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usr`|`address`|The recipient of the gem tokens|
|`gemAmt`|`uint256`|The amount of gem tokens to buy|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of stablecoin paid|


### to18ConversionFactor

Returns the factor to convert gem amounts to 18 decimals


```solidity
function to18ConversionFactor() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The 18-decimal conversion factor|


### gem

Returns the address of the gem (collateral) token


```solidity
function gem() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
